reviews.comment:
Si están apurados, busquen otra estación de Servicio, los playeros son atentos, pero son muy lentos y se toman todo el tiempo del mundo en despachar el combustible, solo un vehículo por vez, te limpian los vidrios aunque no lo pidas, luego proceden al cobro todavía aún mas lentos, no te dejan que mientras tanto procedas a cargar vos mismo, te dicen ESPERE, luego en lugar de cargarte el combustible, se van 5 minutos a su oficina, luego vuelven y recien comienzan la rutina de atenderte. Una verdadera prueba a tú paciencia.

(Translated by Google)
If you're in a hurry, look for another gas station. The attendants are attentive, but they're incredibly slow and take forever to pump the fuel, only serving one vehicle at a time. They clean your windshield even if you don't ask, then proceed to the payment even more slowly. They don't let you pump your own gas in the meantime; they just tell you to WAIT. Then, instead of pumping your gas, they go to their office for five minutes, only to return and then begin the routine of serving you. A real test of your patience.
reviews.name: accounts/109853746269412609224/locations/2511053987051317301/reviews/ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURsZ05ycjZRRRAB

reviews.comment:
Soy socio de ACA desde que tengo memoria, la estación de servicio de YPF tiene muy mal servicio, por lo menos por parte de algunos despachadores, (los mayores) atienden mal. No ofrecen servicios,  revisar líquidos o limpiar vidrios. Y la masiva de aire para los neumáticos no funcionan nunca

(Translated by Google)
I've been an ACA member for as long as I can remember, and the YPF service station has terrible service, at least from some of the attendants (the older ones). They're rude. They don't offer any services, like checking fluids or cleaning windshields. And the tire inflation pump never works.
